description: This file implements Common Gateway Interface (CGI) functionalities for a web server, including handling local redirections, encoding CGI variable names, and constructing CGI environment headers. It contains functions for managing request headers, encoding variables, and interacting with request and server data.

methods.name: handler_t http_cgi_local_redir(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles local redirects in CGI requests based on RFC 3875, reprocessing the request with a new target URI when certain conditions are met.

methods.name: void http_cgi_encode_varname(buffer * const b,const char * const restrict s,const size_t len,const int is_http_header)
methods.description: Encodes a variable name for CGI environment variables, optionally prefixing with 'HTTP_' and transforming characters to uppercase and underscores.

methods.name: int http_cgi_headers(request_st * const r,http_cgi_opts * const opts,http_cgi_header_append_cb cb,void * vdata)
methods.description: Constructs the CGI environment headers based on request data, headers, server info, and configuration, invoking a callback for each header.
